text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the academy library,
I found Biwa Hayahide looking deep in thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yo, what's up, Hayahide?
You've got total worry lines on your brow~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Palmer-kun. In truth, I am scheduled for an interview today, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I find myself pondering how to answer regarding the theme: 'The Secret to Popularity'...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, an interview, huh.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Why not use this as a reference?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, the academy PR magazine. Indeed, looking at interviews of other students might serve as—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Hm? This photo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's Nature and Turbo's photo.
Both of them have great expressions!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is truly refreshing to look at.
Their mutual respect comes across clearly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wonder what their state of mind was during the photoshoot. If possible, I would have liked to ask them, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then you're in luck♪
Nature was right out in the hallway just a second ago!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Is that true?
Thank you, I'll go check!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Nature-kun, do you have a moment!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Hayahide-san?
Did you need something from me...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Actually, I wanted to ask about your mindset when you took that promotional photo.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Both of you looked so radiant; I wanted to use it as a reference for an upcoming interview.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... that one. Well, honestly, it just turned out that way while I was dealing with Turbo running wild, so to speak...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I mean, saying 'running wild' sounds dramatic, but it was no big deal. It's just the usual for her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Besides, I guess that's part of what makes her so charming.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She's completely reckless, you know. Both in daily life and on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even against opponents she clearly has zero chance against, she charges ahead without hesitation and leads at full throttle.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She never thinks about pacing herself, so running out of steam halfway is pretty much a given, but even so—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: THIS IS WHAT IT MEANS TO NEVER GIVE UUUUUUUPPPPPPP!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —She never gives up on winning.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seeing her like that makes even someone like me start thinking... maybe I want to win too, or something...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, haha...! Talking like this really isn't my style, is it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Feel free to, um, just let it go in one ear and out the—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nature-kun—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see. You met Turbo-kun, saw her desperate drive, and thought 'I want to win.' And then—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —That feeling is something I am very familiar with as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Their unyielding resolve, their burning thirst for victory... Witnessing that made my own heart tremble.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And I thought to myself: I don't want to lose to them. I don't want to be left behind. —'I want to win.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In the past, all I thought about was 'not losing.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Whatever popularity I had merely stemmed from that sense of stability. ...However:

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Along this rigorous path, I was fortunate enough to gain irreplaceable friends.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And step by step, I changed. Yes—competing and striving together with those two instilled in me a fierce desire to 'win.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If there is a reason why I captivate so many people—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It is this passionate drive to 'win.' The burning heart that my dear friends taught me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide spoke candidly from the heart. Just as I thought this would make a wonderful interview article—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see... so that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I won't back down either...! In the next race, I'm definitely not gonna lose!
